algorithm: Early return for zero output bytes before reading fill/input. Positive output with no images or zero tile rows/columns becomes fill-only, preserving null input permissions.
Compute byte-pattern zero flag once, snapshot workers supplied by caller, partition complete output rows using existing partition and parallel_min. No pool or validation changes.

For each output row identify padding versus a tile row once. Fill full padding/unused rows. Within occupied rows copy active tile spans directly, fill leading/intertile/trailing holes only; each output byte is written once.
Reuse a local fill-span operation across full rows and holes: zero memset or exact pixel-pattern memcpy doubling, always whole pixels and disjoint initialized spans. No floating loads/arithmetic.

Preserve signed image/row/column/channel strides and unaligned POD reads. Contiguous rows use existing memcpy. Single-channel itemsize4 strided rows use fixed4-byte memcpy; eligible columnstride+8 AVX2 rows invoke the unchanged proven operation. Other POD widths/channels use existing exact byte copy routes.

Choose SIMD eligibility outside worker/row loops; the helper has no allocation, FP, private pool, Python or runtime-dispatch work. Scalar disable and portable builds retain the constant4-byte copy route.
